How we work

No assumptions. Prove it, then build it.

Every project runs to the same engineering discipline, whatever the sector.

V

V-model development

Requirements down one side, verification back up the other. Nothing ships untested against what it was meant to do.

PoC

Proof of concept first

The risky parts get proven on the bench before anything goes near a production design.

0

Zero assumptions

If it hasn't been measured or verified, it isn't treated as fact. Simple as that.
